verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing app with public docs and a GitHub repo, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. A direct probe of getsill.app/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and nothing in the pack shows any other agent-oriented documentation. Ordinary human-facing docs and a README do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
